data.headline: Quanta Services Announces Fourth Quarter And Full-Year 2025 Earnings Release & Webcast Schedule
data.summary: Quanta Services, Inc. (NYSE: PWR) announced today that it will release its fourth quarter and full-year 2025 financial results on Thursday, February 19, 2026, before the market opens.
